gallery.title: File:Gedenkstein für die D-Mark im Mühlenmuseum Gifhorn.jpg
gallery.description:
Memorial Stone for the Deutsche Mark at the Internationales Wind- und Wassermühlen-Museum in Gifhorn.
Inscription (translated):
1948 DEUTSCHE MARK 2001

On December 31, 2001, the old Deutsche Mark was symbolically buried here. It was 53 years old and served us well. Lord God, grant the new Euro the necessary courage as well.
